method: Executed differential (evidence tier 1) for every member this increment adds: ../oracle/B8b-peptide-id/driver.cpp compiled with libOpenMS's Release flags against the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 and run twice on ibminode06, each case in a fresh process, both runs byte-identical. Transcribed PeptideIdentification_test.cpp and USI_test.cpp literals are tier 3.

source_files.role: The ported header, including the std::hash specialisation and the SpectrumIdentification alias.
empty(), getScoreComparator, the UID builders, both buildUSI overloads, setExperimentLabel's empty-label rule.
USI parsing, formatting, scan-number extraction and basenames.
Not ported here as a type. Read for isNativeID, getRegExFromNativeID and the regex extractScanNumber overload that USI::extractScanNumberFromNativeID calls.
Already ported (src/identification/run_mapping.rs). Read for getMSRunPaths and getPrimaryMSRunPath, which the UID and USI builders call.
Read for StringUtilsHelper::toInt32 (blank skipping, one '+', std::from_chars).
Read for PeptideHit::ScoreMore and ScoreLess, which getScoreComparator returns.
36 START_SECTIONs; literals for buildUSI, getReferencingHits and std::hash transcribed.
